I was welcomed in as a new patient and given so much advice . The reception team , Zoey , Charlotte , Judith , Helen all have been so helpful . It really is so reassuring to have such a great team which is your first port of call I have some health issues and there help has been great with the transmission over .
I have met dr Mya and again she was very helpful , she listened to me and I came out feeling very happy . I have spoken to Alex a clinical physician who gave me so much help and advice .
Moving to a new surgery so far away was such a huge step for me but the team at pontyates have supported myself and my family so well .
It is very sad that the surgery is under threat of closure . While I was in the surgery last week I spoke to an elderly patient who was so worried about how she will get to another surgery . This really made me think . It is so wrong that they are trying to close such a well run village surgery where many people can walk to and access easily . It is very worrying for all the patients including myself and I do hope that the proposed closure will not happen .
This surgery is in the heart of the community it has genuine caring experienced staff and its closure will be detrimental to a lot of people including myself .
I hope we get some reassurance soon that our surgery will not close
